body:
The structure starts helping people's sore spot instead of grading it.

Someone sets up the routine, the checklist, the standing appointment, and watches the unmanageable thing turn into a Tuesday.

With Saturn sextile Chiron, people can build a container, and the tender project that always needed one is right there.

The scaffolding only holds if somebody assembles it.

The system may look rigid from outside, but a container people choose freely tends to be the opposite of the one that was once imposed on them.
